messages:
Jordan: FYI we're flipping the policy switch for Timeblock allocations on A800 nodes in Sao Paulo (sa-east-1) tomorrow 06:00 UTC. This is intended to improve access during peak APAC windows.
Maya: Timeblock = scheduled time windows per reservation, right?
Jordan: Correct. Customers can reserve fixed daily windows (e.g., 02:00-06:00 UTC) for a lower price and guaranteed capacity.
Victor: Any billing quirks? prorating?
billing-bot: Billing: daily-window commitments billed as a separate SKU with daily pro-rating. See billing docs (internal). Exports include `timeblock_window` column.
Maya: How does this interact with existing fairshare?
Jordan: Timeblocks are orthogonal; they reduce rotational pressure during peak by moving some workloads into off-peak slots. Fairshare still applies for non-timeblock pools.
ops-bot: DEPLOY: timeblock-scheduler v0.9 will roll at 06:00 UTC. Hooks: timeblock-health, timeblock-preempt-count.
Victor: Limits? can customers request arbitrary windows?
Jordan: Beta limits: up to 3 timeblocks per account per-region; windows must be contiguous and at least 2 hours.
Maya: Anything for support docs/console?
Jordan: Console will show a time selection UI and shorthand labels (Morning/Afternoon/Night). SDK adds `timeblock_window` field. Docs PR queued.
Jordan: TL;DR: Timeblock allocations for A800 in Sao Paulo tomorrow 06:00 UTC. Lower-cost scheduled windows, beta caps=3, deploy & canary monitoring attached. Escalate regressions to #incidents.
